speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Shakespeare.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Master Shakespeare. That is twice. The wind is off Bishopsgate. Are you unwell, or only a poet?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Only a poet, Mistress. I am sorry for the name. I still have the last chord, and I was setting a line under it.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Keep the chord, Will, if you can keep it in tune. Four parts. The boys held the close of it, which is more than a cold church usually allows a treble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stone lifted while they sang. I have been trying a line against that lift since the blessing, and the line will not take the weight.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Then leave the line till your mouth is warm. Open vowels, Will. A boy can sing a word he can get his throat round. He cannot sing a judgment.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The anthem had its place before the sermon, Master Morley, which is the right order of a morning this cold. Master Thwaite has had the parish since.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Advent, and St Andrew under it. I began upon the four last things. I reached the second.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Judgment, then. You spent the morning on it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I reached it, Master Shakespeare. I did not finish the four. The other two will keep for another Sunday, and I do not apologise for stopping where the hour stopped.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John was out ahead of us. No sword-bearer at the pew. No halberds at the gate. He looked at nobody from the first collect to the porch.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: It left the aisle to the boys' elbows, and I am glad of the room. I did not speak to him. There was no occasion that wanted a composer in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. A man who is looking at nobody is not a man to begin with, and a churchyard is a poor place to begin.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Nor he to you. In this house a rich man sits under the same words as his neighbours. That is as much as Advent asks of Bishopsgate.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let Bishopsgate ask it indoors. Dinner is on the trivet, and I am not holding it in a porch so you can finish a chord.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming, Mistress. The line can follow me. It has the afternoon, and nowhere else to lodge.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: If you write the boys anything, Will, make it short, and open at the end of the line. A song is not a sermon. Good morrow, Mistress Ansell.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good morrow, Master Morley. Mind the ice by the kennel, Master Shakespeare, or the poet will be flat before he is fed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have my footing. Good morrow, sir. I heard you the second time. On a morning with fewer parts I may hear you the first.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Remember the second head when you are warm. Death has had its Sunday already. Judgment has had this one. Do not make me preach the walk home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I shall not. The other two can wait upon you, not upon me.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then go and eat. God keep you both in the season.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Shut the door after you when you are in. The close does not need another poet standing in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At your heel, Mistress.

speaker: thomas_morley
text: Leave the chord, Will. It will not be warmer for being stood on.
